title: R19 calibration manifest (calibrate-dev output)
description: Validates the flat output of the `calibrate-dev` phase of oczy.experiments.s19_language_organ (Research/19). The manifest is a flat dict produced by CalibrationManifest.to_dict() — every field is a top-level key, no nested objects except `parameter_breakdown`. It carries every value that the `evaluate` phase needs to reproduce the calibrated cortex, every value a human reviewer needs to approve before holdout evaluation, and every audit artifact required to verify the integrity of the calibration. The `evaluate` phase MUST fail closed unless: (1) the supplied manifest hash matches `manifest_sha256`, (2) a nonempty human sign-off ID is provided and matches `signoff_human_signoff_id`, (3) `signoff_thresholds_signed_off` is true, (4) `signoff_oracle_ceiling` is positive, (5) `signoff_dev_articulation_gate` is true, and (6) `c7_available` is true (or evaluation is explicitly blocked). The schema and calibration code never auto-sign. Research/19 and the eval assets are immutable; this schema does not choose or approve any value — it only defines and validates the field structure. An incomplete manifest (missing any required field) fails validation.

schema_version.description: Fixed schema version for the R19 calibration manifest.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the manifest was written. EXCLUDED from the canonical hashed payload so that re-running calibrate-dev at a different time with identical calibration values produces an identical manifest_sha256.

source_commit.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA of the source used for calibrate-dev. An empty string explicitly indicates the commit is unavailable (e.g. running outside a git checkout).

source_archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source tar archive uploaded as the private Kaggle dataset. An empty string explicitly indicates the archive hash is unavailable.

eval_version.description: Human-approved frozen eval version (e.g. v2.1). May be empty if the eval version is unavailable; the evaluate phase fails closed on empty provenance.

eval_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen eval instrument manifest. Verified before and after the run. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

model_repo_id.description: Hugging Face repo id of the frozen language organ (e.g. 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct'). May be empty if the model was loaded from a non-HF source.

model_revision.description: Pinned model revision (snapshot hash or version tag). May be empty if unavailable.

model_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of config.json. Verified before and after the run. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

model_safetensors_sha256.description: SHA-256 of model.safetensors. Verified before and after the run. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

model_params_requires_grad.description: Must be false. All language-organ parameters have requires_grad=False. Arm B steers via inputs_embeds only; no LM parameter is ever updated.

d_embd.description: Frozen LM hidden width. Const because the language organ is fixed (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct).

latent_tokens.description: Number of fixed-width latent tokens in the Arm B control bank. Contract value: 3.

max_labels.description: Maximum number of sense labels for Arm A. Hard cap: 20. Contract value: 20.

arm_b_input_mode.description: Arm B injects the latent control bank via Qwen inputs_embeds. No LM parameter update occurs.

parameter_total.description: Total persistent cortex parameters. Must be <= budget (64000). Contract value: 60388.

parameter_budget.description: Hard parameter budget for the shared cortex.

parameter_breakdown.description: Per-component parameter counts. The calibration code must ensure these sum to parameter_total. Contract values: W_perceive=14336, W_label=320, b_label=20, W_coupler=43008, b_coupler=2688, warm_state=16.

W_perceive.description: Perception weight matrix parameters (d_embd x d_cortex). Contract: 14336.

W_label.description: Label head weight parameters (d_cortex x max_labels). Contract: 320.

W_coupler.description: Latent control coupler weight parameters (d_cortex x latent_tokens x d_embd). Contract: 43008.

b_coupler.description: Latent control coupler bias parameters (latent_tokens x d_embd). Contract: 2688.

fixed_latent_shape.description: Fixed-width latent control bank shape for Arm B. Must be independent of episode count — it does not grow with experiences. Contract shape: [3, 896].

proposed_confidence_threshold.description: Proposed abstain threshold from DEV Phase 0 distribution check. Below this confidence, both arms fall through to the unmodified language organ. This is a PROPOSED value for human review — the schema does not choose or approve it. It may not be changed after seeing holdout.

proposed_specificity_margin.description: Proposed specificity equivalence margin from DEV Phase 0. Specificity must remain within this margin for H-LATENT acceptance. This is a PROPOSED value for human review — the schema does not choose or approve it. It may not be changed after seeing holdout.

cortex_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full serialized cortex artifact (covers head + coupler). Trained on DEV, frozen before any holdout run. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

cortex_artifact_bytes.description: Size of the full serialized cortex artifact in bytes (head + coupler).

cortex_artifact_path.description: Optional relative path to the cortex artifact within the run output directory. Empty string if not set.

coupler_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the serialized Arm B articulation coupler state artifact. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

coupler_bytes.description: Size of the coupler state artifact in bytes.

head_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the serialized shared cortex head state artifact. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

head_bytes.description: Size of the head state artifact in bytes.

label_phrasing_frozen.description: Must be true. Label phrasing is frozen at calibrate-dev time and may not change after seeing holdout.

labels.description: Frozen sense label strings for Arm A. At most 20 labels. Frozen at calibrate-dev time.

dev_split.description: Must be 'dev'. Confirms the distribution check used the DEV split only.

dev_repeatability_std.description: No-update repeatability standard deviation on DEV. Measures variance across repeated runs with the cortex update disabled.

dev_confidence_mean.description: Mean of the head confidence score distribution on DEV.

dev_confidence_std.description: Standard deviation of the head confidence score distribution on DEV.

dev_confidence_min.description: Minimum observed head confidence on DEV.

dev_confidence_max.description: Maximum observed head confidence on DEV.

dev_specificity_acc.description: Specificity accuracy on DEV. Measures how well the cortex distinguishes taught from untaught items.

dev_holdout_ids_discarded.description: Must be true. Calibrate-dev discards all holdout IDs. No holdout item identifiers, scores, or derived values appear in the manifest.

split_salt.description: Split salt. Must match the salt passed to split_probes in both calibrate-dev and evaluate. Contract value: 'v2.2'.

split_fraction.description: Holdout fraction. Must match the fraction passed to split_probes in both calibrate-dev and evaluate. Contract value: 0.3.

c7_reference.description: Reference to the S3.M2a retrieval baseline implementation used for C7. Identifies the frozen retrieval baseline code/config so the evaluate phase can reproduce C7. May be empty if unavailable; the evaluate phase fails closed on empty.

c7_available.description: Whether the S3.M2a retrieval baseline is available for C7. If false, the evaluate phase must block evaluation (cannot compute the external bar).

c7_blocked_reason.description: Required when c7_available is false. States why the C7 retrieval baseline is unavailable and evaluation is explicitly blocked. May be null or absent when c7_available is true.

trace_raw_traces_deleted.description: Must be true. All raw correction traces are deleted via trace_store.delete_all(). Verified by trace_store.verify_zero().

trace_raw_trace_count.description: Must be 0. The raw trace count after deletion, verified by trace_store.verify_zero().

trace_embedding_cache_cleared.description: Must be true. The embedding cache (peek_embedding results from driver) is cleared so no probe-level embedding state leaks into holdout evaluation.

trace_optimizer_state_deleted.description: Must be true. Transient optimizer examples and gradients are deleted after consolidation, before the head state is serialized.

articulation_prompt_text.description: The prompt text supplied to the LM. For Arm B, this is the request text only — no label, corrected_response, correction_utterance, or episode-ID text.

articulation_latent_bank_shape.description: Fixed-width latent control bank shape [latent_tokens, d_embd]. Must be independent of episode count. Contract shape: [3, 896].

articulation_raw_trace_count.description: Must be 0. Raw traces are deleted before evaluation; the articulation audit is emitted after deletion.

articulation_language_organ_hash.description: SHA-256 of the frozen language organ. Must be identical before and after the run, verifying that no LM parameter was updated. An empty string explicitly indicates the hash is unavailable.

articulation_persistent_cortex_bytes.description: Persistent cortex bytes after consolidation. Counts toward the 64k parameter budget. Reported in every scored condition's articulation audit.

articulation_banned_label_text_absent.description: Must be true. No label text appears in the Arm B prompt.

articulation_banned_corrected_response_a.description: Must be true. No corrected_response text appears in the Arm B prompt.

articulation_banned_correction_utterance.description: Must be true. No correction_utterance text appears in the Arm B prompt.

articulation_banned_expected_answer_abse.description: Must be true. No expected answer text appears in the Arm B prompt.

signoff_thresholds_signed_off.description: Must be set to true by human review. calibrate-dev writes false. The evaluate phase rejects any manifest where this is false. The schema and calibration code never auto-sign — no agent may approve its own instrument.

signoff_human_signoff_id.description: Nonempty human approval identifier. Empty when written by calibrate-dev; filled by human review. The evaluate phase requires --signoff-id to match this value exactly.

signoff_oracle_ceiling.description: Oracle ceiling (accuracy with corrected_response prepended as text prefix) measured on DEV. The evaluate phase requires this to be positive — a zero or negative oracle ceiling means the upper bound for text-injection is unmeasurable and the hypothesis cannot be tested.

signoff_dev_articulation_gate.description: DEV articulation gate result. Verifies that Arm B articulation on DEV probes exceeds the no-update baseline (C1). The evaluate phase rejects any manifest where this is false — the coupler must produce a measurable improvement on DEV before holdout evaluation is warranted.

signoff_meta_test_conflation_ok.description: Meta-test conflation pre-check. Verifies that C3 (Arm B) and C2 (Arm A) results are not identical across seeds, which would indicate the two arms are conflated. Fully verified in the evaluate phase.

holdout_accessed.description: Must be false. The schema rejects any manifest that claims holdout access. Calibrate-dev operates on DEV only; holdout evaluation requires a separately signed-off manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON payload. The canonical payload is the full manifest with `created_at` and `manifest_sha256` removed, keys sorted lexicographically, compact separators (no insignificant whitespace), UTF-8 encoded. This makes the manifest hash deterministic and independent of creation timestamp. The evaluate phase MUST fail closed unless the supplied --manifest-hash matches this value AND a nonempty --human-signoff-id is provided.
